title: oxybaphus expansus
intro: Oxybaphus expansus, commonly known as Mexican Evening Primrose or Mexican Evening Star, is a species of flowering plant in the evening primrose family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Oxybaphus expansus include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a sought-after plant for herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of Oxybaphus expansus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
